blurb: Four phases, in the order a trophy hunter should play them. Finish the story first, then the strangers, then sweep the map, then grind what is left. The platinum is the last trophy, not the first goal.

phases.blurb: Chapters 1 to 4 and the finale. Twelve story trophies pop on their own as you play — you cannot miss them, and free roam stays open after the credits. The one job of this phase, besides enjoying the story, is the single possibly missable trophy in the game: meditate at Jason's house in Chapter 1 before the story moves on.
phases.milestone: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
phases.subtitle: Play the story
phases.title: First Light

phases.blurb: Stranger missions unlock as the story advances. Clear each strand to its final mission: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret. Any eight completed strands earn the silver — these six plus two more you meet while exploring are more than enough.
phases.subtitle: Six strands, one silver
phases.title: Strangers of Leonida

phases.blurb: Cards, WAiNK scans, meditation spots, vehicles, garages and the whole map. Do this phase with a guide open: the counts are large (100 scans, 100 vehicles, 18 card sets) and the work is spread across the state. Buy the garages early — storage makes everything else easier.
phases.subtitle: Collectibles and exploration
phases.title: The Leonida Sweep

phases.blurb: Everything that takes repetition: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 50 challenges, 20 races, 5 bank vaults — and the 100% completion gold that ties it all together. Work the checklist after the story (Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion) and let it tell you what is left. The platinum pops when this phase ends.
phases.subtitle: Grind and cleanup
phases.title: The Long Road

title: The Leonida Campaign
